messages:
maya: Heads-up: docs PR #452 (SDK v0.9 examples + migration notes) needs final approvals before EOD release cutoff tomorrow 14:00 PT. cc @sam @jen

sam: On it. I'll do a full pass for accuracy — ETA ~2h.

jen: I fixed a couple link targets and added an SDK streaming snippet. Preview: https://redwood-internal.preview/docs/pr-452

devex-bot: Preview build queued for PR 452 — build id 8765. Status: running.

build-bot: CI: docs-preview failed — link-checker: broken links (2). See logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/8765/logs

jen: ugh, saw that. The raw links pointed at staging. Pushing a tiny patch to replace them with canonical doc paths.

liam: Quick Q: should we gate merge until the feature flag roll? SDK v0.9 flag flips at 23:00 PT — if we merge now the hosted site might expose sections earlier than intended.

elaine: Product preference is to keep new SDK content behind the 'v0.9' selector until the flag flips. Can we keep this under /next or use a versioned nav? @maya?

maya: Agreed — keep it in /next and do not alter stable nav. For previews use `mkdocs --config mkdocs.next.yml build`. If CI is green and no blockers, we'll merge but leave stable untouched.

sam: Sounds good. I'll review for any accidental stable nav edits and request changes if needed.

jen: Patch pushed — I reverted the stable nav change and moved new pages under `next/`. New preview: https://redwood-internal.preview/docs/pr-452/next — rebuild queued.

devex-bot: Preview build 8765 updated — status: running.

build-bot: Automated check: cross-version link warnings (internal anchors). Please confirm anchor names used in migration guide.

jen: Fixed anchors and clarified the migration step. Added code note: `set client.timeout = 30_000` in the examples.

sam: LGTM. Approving now. @maya will you handle the merge timing?

maya: Plan: hold merge until tomorrow 13:00 PT to coordinate with the release window and the feature-flag flip at 23:00 PT. If no regressions, I'll merge at 13:05 PT and leave docs under /next until the flag flips.

elaine: I'll add a blurb to the release notes: "What's new: SDK v0.9 beta docs available under /next; stable docs unchanged until flag flip."

jen: :thumbsup: I'll monitor the preview and be on-call for any last-minute fixes.

maya: Merging at 13:05 PT unless an objection. If anything fails, cancel with `/deploy cancel` and ping me immediately.

sam: no objections. :thumbsup:

build-bot: Merged by maya at 1792102850 — PR 452 merged to main, docs published under /next, stable nav untouched.
